I am 64 years old. I finished primary school and have farmed 7 mu in Quzhou County for 45 years. It is just me and my wife working the land. We have a well, so when the crops need water I pump it up myself.

I split my 7 mu into two pieces. I put 4 mu into cotton because cotton is cash money. The other 3 mu I sow with winter wheat, and the day after I harvest that wheat in June I plant maize on the same 3 mu. I have done it this way for more than 20 years. I know these fields like the back of my hand.

For cotton: In late April I rotary till the 4 mu. I buy hybrid cotton seed, 3 jin per mu. I put one full bag of compound fertilizer on each mu as base — that is 50 kg per mu. The bag says it has nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium. At flowering time I top-dress with half a bag of urea per mu, and I do this again at boll stage. So I use 50 kg of urea per mu total. I irrigate 3 times from my well: right after planting, at flowering, and when the bolls are swelling. I spray pesticide 10 times. I have to. The bollworm and the aphids never rest. Last year I got 240 kg of seed cotton per mu. This year I expect 250 kg per mu if the weather does not turn bad.

For wheat: I sow it in October on 3 mu. I use an improved short-stalk variety, 30 jin of seed per mu. Last autumn I rotary tilled before sowing and put down 40 kg of compound fertilizer per mu. When the wheat turns green in March I spread 25 kg of urea per mu. I irrigate 3 times: once before winter freeze, once at jointing, and once at grain filling. I spray pesticide 3 times — twice for bugs, once for the rust that came two years ago. I expect 450 kg per mu. My wheat has given me 440 to 460 kg per mu for five years now.

For maize: The day after wheat harvest I no-till plant hybrid maize on those same 3 mu. I use 1.5 packages of seed per mu. At planting I put 40 kg of compound fertilizer per mu. When the plants are knee-high I top-dress with 20 kg of urea per mu. I irrigate twice if the summer rain is not enough. I spray 3 times: herbicide once, insecticide twice. I expect 500 kg per mu. Last year I got 480, but the year before I got 520.

I think about costs every morning. A bag of compound fertilizer is 160 yuan now. Urea is 100 yuan. For the whole farm I will spend more than 2,000 yuan just on fertilizer. But I will not cut back. My neighbor tried to save 300 yuan on fertilizer last year and his cotton yield dropped by 80 kg per mu. He lost over 1,000 yuan. I would rather waste a little fertilizer than lose yield. A bad harvest is a disaster. Wasting fertilizer is just a cost. I watch Old Wang across the road. He uses the same amounts as me. If he changes something and it works, I will think about it. This year I will do what I did last year. Change is risky.
